description: Flomveier - Lier is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lier kommune. Datasettet inneholder resultat av analysen som viser åpne flomveier. Det vil si at man ser på hvor i terrenget vannet vil renne ved store nedbørsmengder over kort tid. Her tas det i utgangspunktet ikke hensyn til avløp, stikkrenner, kulverter og bekker i rør. Coverage: Lier kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Lier kommune. Its keywords include Samfunnssikkerhet, Det offentlige kartgrunnlaget, Lier kommune. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2024-03-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
